extraction.Name: Ida Huston
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded by D. A. Sinclair on August 21, 1918
extraction.Buyer: Ida Roubideaux, formerly Ida Huston, Huston Roubideaux and Sylvester S. Roubideaux conveyed that part in section 20 to Samuel P. English for $1.00 and other valuable consideration. On July 11, 1919 Ida Roubideaux conveyed the remainder to Elmer Huston for $1500.00.
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612442 issued; the west half of the southeast quarter of section 17, and the east half of the northeast quarter of section 20, township 98, range 78. Receipt for the patent signed by the allottee February 11, 1918. Allottee also known as Ida Roubideaux (formerly Ida Huston).
